checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Task 9.2 is marked ✅ (review-code.md:38), but tasks.md:55 requires Stryker scores ≥95% (min 90%, M5) for each of sun.ts, dayPeriods.ts, dayPeriodWindows.ts, dayPeriodStops.ts, hourCells.ts, sunCoordinates.ts, presenter/dayColours.ts, presenter/hourStrip.ts and views/shared/dayTrackGradient.ts. The review's own Mutation section measured only dayPeriodWindows.ts, dayPeriodStops.ts and dayPeriodTransitions.ts and says the rest were 'not measured'; no other report in the task folder has scores for them. A ticked task with no evidence must not be ✅; it should be ⚠️/❌ with a finding (CRITICAL if ticked but undone).

M5 (proposal.md:141, 'Mutation score ≥ 95% (minimum acceptable 90%) on the new and changed files of src/model/ and src/presenter/') is marked ⚠️ but set aside as 'not a finding' (review-code.md:70). The acceptance criteria require a finding for any requirement left untested. Raise one, for example asking the user to run the scoped Stryker runs as CLAUDE.md says ('When a full run is needed, ask the user to run it and share the report').

The verdict 'Ready' (review-code.md:141) is inconsistent while ticked task 9.2 and metric M5 are still unverified; it should wait for the mutation scores, or the missing scores should be an open finding that blocks it.
